title: ScaleAdministration
description: WHO-5 / NGSE / IPS administration (PRD §10.2), scored deterministically — no model involved in scoring, only response collection.

responses.description: Raw per-item responses. WHO-5: 5 items, 0-5 Likert. NGSE: 8 items, 1-5 Likert. IPS: 9 items, 1-5 Likert.

score.description: Deterministically computed per instrument's published scoring method.

floor_policy_triggered.description: true when a very-low WHO-5 score fires the supportive-resources message (PRD §16 risk 5). Never a diagnostic message.
